definitions.explanation: The area of a baseball field within the baselines, or the players who defend that area.

examples.japanese: {内野|ないや}ゴロでアウトになった。
examples.english: He was out on an infield grounder.

examples.japanese: {内野手|ないやしゅ}が{素早|すばや}く{捕球|ほきゅう}した。
examples.english: The infielder quickly caught the ball.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{内野|ないや}の{守備|しゅび}が{得意|とくい}だ。
examples.english: He is good at infield defense.

notes:
{内野|ないや} refers to the diamond-shaped area of a baseball field enclosed by the baselines. It also refers collectively to the players who defend this area.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {内野手|ないやしゅ} (infielder)
- {内野|ないや}ゴロ (infield grounder)
- {内野|ないや}フライ (infield fly)
- {内野|ないや}の{守備|しゅび} (infield defense)

INFIELD POSITIONS:
- {一塁手|いちるいしゅ} (first baseman)
- {二塁手|にるいしゅ} (second baseman)
- {三塁手|さんるいしゅ} (third baseman)
- {遊撃手|ゆうげきしゅ} (shortstop)
